description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for importing recipes in a web application. It includes methods for initializing the import process, previewing import options, and submitting the import form, handling database interactions and preparing data for views.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Recipe::Import
classes.description: Controller class handling recipe import operations, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Initializes the import process by loading the recipe and setting up the importer object.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Prepares data for the import preview page, including candidate ingredients, units, articles, and recipe name adjustments.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles the submission of the import form, validating and importing the recipe data into the database.
